description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeePictureService component within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving employee pictures, access control, saving pictures, adjusting picture sizes, and generating ETags for caching. The test class uses mocking extensively to simulate dependencies and verifies the behavior of the service methods.

classes.name: EmployeePictureServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that validates the functionality of EmployeePictureService, covering access control, data retrieval, caching, picture manipulation, and size adjustment.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Tests that the service correctly provides an instance of EmployeePictureDao.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies that the service returns an Employee's picture if access is granted based on user roles and self-identification.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumberNotAllowed
methods.description: Checks that the service returns null when access to the employee picture is denied.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Ensures that the service retrieves an EmpPicture object by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Validates the ability of the service to save and return an EmpPicture object.

methods.name: testPictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Tests the picture size adjustment logic with different image samples.

methods.name: getPictureSizeAdjustDataProvider
methods.description: Provides image fixture data and expected size mappings for the pictureSizeAdjust test.

methods.name: testGetETagByEmpPicture
methods.description: Checks that the service correctly generates an ETag for an employee picture for caching purposes.
